videos.headline: Connor Bazelak drops a 46-yard dime for an early Bowling Green TD
videos.description: Connor Bazelak has plenty time to make a pretty throw to Odieu Hiliare who runs it in for a 46-yard touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Connor Bazelak drops a 46-yard dime for an early Bowling Green TD) 2023/12/26

videos.headline: Minnesota kicker just short on 2-point effort from wild formation
videos.description: Minnesota breaks out into a unique formation on a 2-point attempt, but kicker Dragan Kesich is stopped just short of the goal line on a valiant effort.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Minnesota kicker just short on 2-point effort from wild formation) 2023/12/26

videos.headline: Cole Kramer finds Elijah Spencer in the end zone for a Minnesota TD
videos.description: Cole Kramer weaves a pass to Elijah Spencer who is found in the end zone for a touchdown catch.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Cole Kramer finds Elijah Spencer in the end zone for a Minnesota TD) 2023/12/26

videos.headline: Odieu Hiliare goes airborne to make a spectacular catch
videos.description: Odieu Hiliare runs a shifty route and keeps his composure as he hauls in the nice pass from Connor Bazelak.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Odieu Hiliare goes airborne to make a spectacular catch) 2023/12/26

videos.headline: Bowling Green picks off pass from Cole Kramer after he takes a hit
